method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: From the seat of the employee (and, for platform work, the employee-like worker), for the WA cradle-to-grave lives: ss 12 (vocational placement, junior employee), 13, 15AA (as an input), 15C, 15N, 15P, 22(5) and (7), 23, 45, 65, 65A, 67, 70, 71(3), 72A with reg 2.00, 76, 84, 87, 90, 96, 104, 106, 106A, 111, 115, 116B, 117, 118, 119, 121, 123, 382, 383 with reg 2.13, 385, 386, 389, 392(5), 394, 530, 536 with reg 3.46, 536KL, 536KM, 536KMA, 536LD, 536LU with reg 1.08AA, 544, 545(3) and (5), 548 with reg 4.01 (small claims capped at $100,000; no higher amount is prescribed). Modern award rates, the national minimum wage, and the current high income thresholds are inputs (the thresholds with the floors the Regulations guarantee: $100,000 and $175,000). Long service leave, enterprise agreements, casual conversion, general protections and civil penalties are out.
seat: the employee (and, for platform work, the employee-like worker of s 15P)
